prompt: Audit of Series A pitch deck problem slide

assertions.text: Content type is correctly identified as 'pitch deck' or 'investor deck'
Output uses the structured format: CONTENT TYPE, OVERALL SCORE, SCORECARD, FINDINGS, NARRATIVE ARC, GAP MATRIX, TOP 3 PRIORITIES
The phrase 'exciting new chapter' is flagged as lifestyle-relocation language
The slide is critiqued for missing market-level / investor-grade problem framing (not just buyer pain)
Absence of quantified data (market size, cost of failure) is identified as a gap
A rewrite of the problem slide is provided
